d: At Halloween, the team takes on a case to prove the existence of ghosts on the Queen Mary but find a ship on a deadly collision course; Walter considers taking note of Paige's interests to benefit their relationship.
A device that can prevent a nuclear meltdown is tracked through the Los Angeles sewers; Walter learns to listen and not offer advice to Paige; the team meets their new neighbor.

Team Scorpion visits a renaissance festival, but the revelry is cut short when a group tries to rob a nearby police evidence locker; Paige grows weary of Walter pointing out the historical inaccuracies at the festival.
Team Scorpion becomes stranded on a floating island of trash they were trying to destroy; Toby works with Cabe to uncover the details of his father's death.
Team Scorpion tries to help a father and his daughter when their plane crashes nearby; Paige helps Walter navigate his feelings about Cabe's possible future in prison.

st: Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)
d: The team anxiously awaits the verdict of Cabe's trial which could send him to prison; they use their nervous energy to try saving a dog stuck in a cistern.
On Christmas Eve, Walter becomes unconscious after falling down the stairs and enters a dream world where Team Scorpion never existed.
When Toby saves a troubled teen from a gang beating, he stumbles upon a hidden group of runaways.
Toby tries to help the sister of a shooting victim find out who killed her brother.
When Toby sees a woman revive a badly injured baby, he becomes curious about her gift.
Toby uses his gift to help Detective Marks gather intelligence from the traumatized victim of a serial rapist.

When an important trial is jeopardized after Sarah's testimony is challenged by a former rival in court, it's up to Charlie, Rex and the rest of the Major Crimes team to uncover new evidence to save the case before time runs out.
The maid-of-honor winds up dead after a bachelorette party; it's up to Charlie and Rex to untangle the events of the night.
When Rex finds a body with signs of foul play during Charlie and Sarah's romantic weekend getaway, they discover the community they're staying in may be more hostile than it looks.
After a popular physiotherapist is murdered, the team must investigate the victims of his alleged sexual assaults in order to track down the killer before they strike again.
Charlie's Aunt Miranda and her friends are caught investigating an investment fraud scheme, so it's up to Charlie and Rex to get to the source of the fraud.
When a starlet is killed onstage, Rex takes on a starring role while Charlie goes behind the scenes.
When Jesse's sister contacts him for help, Jesse, Sarah and Rex head to Northern Ontario and find themselves in the middle of a deadly situation.

The team finds itself in a tense and unprecedented situation when Bull faces off against Marissa and her new boss in court, following her departure from the company; Taylor's professional life works against her during her custody battle.

The TAC team gets a rare glimpse into Bull's personal life when his estranged brother of 13 years, Jacob Bull, unexpectedly arrives; a financial investor is accused by the FBI of running a Ponzi scheme with his father.

Bull helps his friend mount a diminished capacity defense for a sergeant accused of killing a fellow soldier; a French gallery owner needs legal assistance to stop an auction house from selling a piece of art that should be repatriated.

Bull helps an agoraphobic client bring a wrongful death suit against the alleged killer of his beloved aunt, but the client's inability to testify in person threatens the trial; Chunk's new relationship hits a snag when his mother visits.
The surgeon who saved Bull's life after his heart attack is sued for malpractice; Taylor fights the urge to check into the background of Henri Fray, Marissa's new love interest.

Bull and Izzy experience marital discord when Bull has the team lead the defense for his ex-girlfriend; personal conflicts abound for the TAC team when Chunk finds himself defending Diana in court against his boyfriend and prosecutor, Robert.
Izzy hires Bull to defend a jockey accused of committing arson against a stable owner who fired him.

Bull puts aside his personal grievances to help AUSA Reilly, who prosecuted him for jury tampering, bring one of the world's most dangerous drug lords to justice; the pair enter into a hesitant partnership.

When Bull is sidelined with a back injury, Marissa and Chunk are forced to go to court without him to defend Marissa's closest childhood friend, Kyla, a tech CEO accused of wrongfully terminating an employee.
Bull breaks from the stress he's been under for months when a mysterious delivery causes him to black out for hours, leaving him with no memory of his movements.
When Bull handles the defense of a building owner accused of killing tenants by carbon monoxide poisoning, the case rocks Bull and the team to their core.
Bull and the team head to court one last time to finalize a negligent homicide defense that will change the nature of their company and their lives forever.
Dr. Jason Bull uses psychology, intuition and data to create strategies to help clients of his trial consulting firm win cases.
The team goes undercover on an oil rig to find dirt on a crooked CEO who is covering up oil spills.
The team sneaks into R.I.Z. to stop them from destroying the electrical grid, but they need Harry's help.
When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.
When skeletons are discovered in the backyard of a home in Virginia, family secrets and past racial divisions are brought to light.
When a young boy disappears from his home in St. Louis, the team examines a similar cold case for clues.
Blake must work with her retired police captain father and her detective brother to solve a series of murders in Kansas City.
A murder investigation results in Garcia delving into her hacker past -- and reconnecting with a former flame.
As the team searches for a vigilante killer in Cleveland, Rossi's former Marine sergeant goes missing in Los Angeles; J.J.'s secret catches up with her.
When J.J. is abducted, the team looks into her time at the State Department in hope of finding clues regarding her disappearance.
The team searches for a pair of suspects responsible for several murders near Pittsburgh; Morgan and Garcia make Valentine's Day plans with their significant others.
The BAU makes startling discoveries as they search for a 4-year-old girl who went missing while staying with a relative.
The BAU must determine the true cause and motive when several drowned people are discovered in the Las Vegas desert.
Three bodies bitten by humans and animals are found in a shallow grave; Garcia and Reid hide their preparation for a company fitness test from Morgan.
Morgan's visit with a survivor of unusual stabbings in upstate New York leads to more questions about the case.
The discovery of two murder victims in West Virginia uncovers a long-simmering feud between two families.
The team searches for a commonality when a series of target abductions take place; Savannah is frustrated with Morgan's traveling.

When people are killed by arsenic poisoning and handwritten death threats are found, the team pursues a suspect fascinated by Greek mythology; Hotch is worried about participating in a Career Day at Jack's school.
When prostitutes are murdered in Texas, their deaths seem to have religious overtones; members of the team are put at risk throughout the course of the investigation.
The investigation in Texas reveals a deep web of corruption; Garcia must save a friend.
The team investigates a series of murders with unidentifiable victims in Bakersfield, Calif.; agent Kate Callahan joins the team.
The team members search for a vengeful suspect who was once abused; Garcia travels to Texas to confront the person she shot.
The BAU team goes to Colorado to investigate when a passenger jet crashes; the incident reminds Kate of a family tragedy.
A body is found covered in scratches, leading the BAU to believe that the person responsible has a chronic skin disorder.

Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.
Barnaby investigates the death of an elderly woman who witnessed a shocking event.
Chief Inspector Barnaby is called in to investigate when a best-selling novelist is suspected in the murder of a local writers club's secretary.
A real razor is substituted for a fake one in a drama group's production of "Amadeus," resulting in the death of an actor.
Residents of the village of Morton Fendle invest in the local craft center, boosting community spirit; Barnaby investigates after the wife of the center's owner disappears, and a neighbour is killed.
After a truck transporting liquid explosive is hijacked by criminals, Charlie and Rex find themselves in a race against time to prevent the case from blowing sky-high.

st: A Stab in the Dark Web
d: As Major Crimes investigates a dark web marketplace, Charlie and Rex protect a witness in their home.
While Sarah embarks on a wilderness adventure, Charlie and Rex investigate the murder of a college professor.
After a journalist is killed searching for buried pirate treasure, Charlie and Rex dig deep into the competitive world of treasure-hunters to unearth the killer.
A stock market guru's fortune is stolen, setting Charlie and Rex on the trail of a very surprising thief.
While St. John's celebrates Mardi Gras, Charlie and Rex investigate a targeted killing spree.
After an elite hockey prospect is found dead, Charlie and Jesse disagree over the prime suspect in the case.

After a raw diamond is found at the crime scene of a murder, Major Crimes sets up a stakeout to take down the suspected gem smugglers; an undisclosed team connection threatens to derail the investigation.
Charlie and Rex receive an award for heroism while Major Crimes investigates an extremist threat.
Charlie, Rex and Sarah travel to an isolated island community caught up in a resettlement dispute; Donovan tries to stop a British police officer from derailing the investigation.
Rex's starring role in a television commercial is interrupted by the murder of one of the agency's ad executives.
The Major Crimes team is forced to turn against Jesse when he becomes the prime suspect in a bank robbery.
After the owner of a construction company is found dead, Charlie and Rex track the killer to an underground casino; Major Crimes goes undercover to solve the case.
Murdoch must prove his innocence amid corruption; Ogden is kidnapped.
Murdoch and Watts discover fraud after a wine connoisseur is poisoned.
A recording device made by Alexander Graham Bell assists in the investigation of a murder at a dinner honoring Helen Keller.
Murdoch investigates a surgeon performing cutting-edge organ transplants.

When Bull assists the U.S. Attorney's office with a manslaughter trial against a real estate magnate, his penchant for winning goes into overdrive as he realizes the defendant is trying to use Diana to antagonize him during the proceedings.

When a state governor and the co-owner of a skydiving company die during a jump, Bull helps the co-owner's brother and daughter fight a lawsuit filed by the governor's widow; Bull and his frequent trial collaborator are on opposing sides in court.

Bull risks losing his business when he fronts the money to help thousands of people bring a class action suit against a corrupt bank; Benny hurts the case by his attraction to a client and his anxiety over a secret he's keeping from Bull.
Bull and Chunk's friendship is tested when Bull helps the man suspected of murdering Nella Wester, Chunk's fashion mentor.
When Bull assists Jules Caffrey, a high-powered attorney on trial for his fiancée's murder, he takes advantage of his client's penchant for courtroom theatrics.

Bull tries to prove temporary insanity for a client who was brainwashed by a cult-like spiritual learning center to kill his father; Danny and Chunk look for the perpetrator responsible for their client's reprogramming.

Bull agrees to consult on three cases for criminal attorney J.P. Nunnelly in exchange for her help defending Benny, who is on trial for misconduct related to his former career with the District Attorney's office.

Bull and J.P. Nunnelly clash over their client, a computer cloud company that is battling the FBI to retain privacy over its client files, on the first of three cases to repay her for defending his brother, Benny, at trial.
When a BAU member gets in trouble in Mexico, the team enlists the services of the International Response Team for help.
The BAU looks into the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians; Reid gets bad news.
The BAU investigates a series of disfiguring acid attacks on young men and women; Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings.
A mother steps forward with valuable information for the BAU to aid in their investigation of an unsub known as the bone crusher; Reid must adapt to a new set of rules in prison.
The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating simultaneously when victims killed in two different ways are discovered in the same city; the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison.
